is: Account use cases — founding, renaming, deleting an Account and the membership lifecycle (invitations, roles, leaving, ownership transfer, listing), one Command/Query + Output + `#[use_case]` method file per action; the module root `../account.rs` holds the `Accounts` namespace, `AccountError`, `AccountResult`.

fs.name: change_handle.rs
fs.role: rename under the rate-limit + quarantine rules (DD 27852802)

fs.name: create.rs
fs.role: found an Account — its name checked by the rule for a name safe to show, Atta's ShowableName (the Den's name rule without its / clause, so "AC/DC Studio" is founded): a refused name answers InvalidName before any handle check or mint, an accepted one is stored as the rule keeps it; handle uniqueness + quarantine checks, mints a DID, seats the founder as Owner

fs.name: delete.rs
fs.role: Owner-gated soft-delete (has facts) or hard-delete (none); retries the did:plc tombstone on hard delete

fs.name: den.rs
fs.role: identity's Den arm for `/account/<did>`: open by standing to a member when live, to its Owner when deactivated, else absent, after the same three reads for every cause; named by its stored name, else its handle; its system folders, `characters` empty until shared Characters are modeled

fs.name: facts.rs + facts/exist.rs
fs.role: has-facts probe feeding delete's soft-vs-hard branch; stub, always false

fs.name: leave.rs
fs.role: a member leaves; blocked for the Owner

fs.name: list.rs
fs.role: the caller's own memberships (self-view scope); keeps only the memberships whose Account den's access check opens (a not-found drops it, a store failure fails the read), each listing named by the check's proof

fs.name: role.rs + role/{grant,revoke}.rs
fs.role: grant (change an existing member's role; never seats) or revoke a member's Role

fs.name: served_name.rs + served_name/tests.rs
fs.role: ServedName, an Account's name as every Account output serves it (the list, founding, a handle change): the stored name as Atta's ShowableName keeps it, else the Account's handle; built only From<&Account>, so a stored name never leaves as-is while the row keeps its text

fs.name: transfer_ownership.rs
fs.role: reassign the Owner role to another member

fs.name: workflow.rs + workflow/{create,delete}.rs + workflow/column/**
fs.role: the account's boards — create/delete a board, add/rename/remove/reposition its columns, and place or remove a commission card in a column; workflow/den.rs is commission's Den arm for an Account's `workflows` folder and its Workflows (WorkflowPlace), listing an Account's Workflows from its own list, each Private

refs.title: Roles
refs.governs: role/grant.rs: a grant changes an existing member's role and never seats anyone; role/revoke.rs; ownership moves only by transfer

Board Ordering — Fractional Position Keys, Anchor Placement and One Card per Board
refs.governs: workflow/column/** use cases: anchor (after) resolved in the domain, stale anchor → 409 anchor-not-in-column, re-placing a card is a MOVE; no read-in-transaction, no row locks

refs.title: My Den — Rulings from the First Slice's Design Study
refs.governs: den.rs: an Account's system folders (D7); a deactivated Account opens to its Owner only, listed only when deleted nodes are asked for (D13); a stored name the rule refuses shows the handle (D19); one not-found (D21)

notes: `require_live_account` (in `../account.rs`) is the shared liveness gate: existence is settled BEFORE standing, because `role_of` reads the membership table with no tombstone predicate. An unknown id and a soft-deleted account get the same answer. (DD 23003138)

Ordering rule, uniform across `invitation/issue`, `invitation/revoke`, `role/grant`, `role/revoke` and `workflow/column/commission/set_in_column`: the actor's own standing is settled before the target is looked up, and before any `provision` (in `invitation/issue`, a WRITE keyed to a caller-named DID). The refusals below the actor's check are distinguishable on the wire, so probing first leaks membership and actor class. A grant never provisions and never seats: it changes an existing member's role, a target with no membership is `NotAMember`, and a newcomer joins only by accepting an invitation.

Two rails put a commission card on a board: PULL (the commission is publicly visible) or PUSH (the actor's OWN standing or OWN view grant). View keys are per-User, so membership of the owning account lifts nothing. Failure is the commission not-found, never `IncorrectRole`. (DD 29130754)

`account/facts/exist.rs` is a stub that always answers false and injects nothing; like every `#[use_case]` it is wrapped for logging (its `use_case{name}` span, start and outcome). It feeds `delete`'s soft-vs-hard branch, and `delete` carries the open `FIXME` for it.
